text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs cabinet meeting.
- Letter from Saddam to Tunisian president.
- Saddam's envoy continues meeting with Moroccan officials.
- Foreign Minister Mohammed Saeed al-Sahaf meets his Austrian counterpart in Vienna.
- A report by Arab league blames Turkey for unfair distribution of waters from both Tigris and Euphrates rivers.
- Baath party official receives Indian delegation.
- French delegation to visit Baghdad to assess Iraq's medical needs.
- (The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Commentary attacks U.S. policy of dual containment.
- Study says one of the last two oil barrels in the world should come from Iraq.
